name: PMKSY – Per Drop More Crop (Drip & Sprinkler Subsidy)
summary: Subsidy for installing drip or sprinkler irrigation, which saves water and improves yield.

benefits.headline: 45% to 55% subsidy on drip and sprinkler systems
details: Small and marginal farmers get 55% financial assistance; other farmers get 45%.
Assistance is available for up to 5 hectares per beneficiary.
Subsidy is released electronically (DBT) after the system is installed and verified.

summary: You are a farmer with agricultural land (individual or group), in a state that has opened the scheme.
You have a water source for the system, such as a borewell, well, canal or pond.
You buy the system from a supplier approved by your state's Agriculture/Horticulture department.

rules.label: You have farmland
rules.pass_text: You have farmland registered in KisanAI.
rules.fail_text: You need agricultural land to claim this subsidy.
rules.unknown_text: Add your farm details so we can check this.

rules.label: A water source for the system
rules.fail_text: You will need a water source such as a well, borewell, canal or pond. The scheme also supports farm ponds and water-storage structures.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us what water source you irrigate from.

verify: Applications are handled by your State Agriculture/Horticulture department, so confirm that the scheme is open in your district and which crops/components are covered.

benefit_tiers.text: Because your holding is small or marginal, you qualify for the higher 55% subsidy.
For your holding size the subsidy is 45%.

adjust.reason: You need a water source first

documents.name: Land ownership record (or lease document)
documents.note: Rules on leased land differ by state.

documents.name: Caste certificate
documents.note: Only if your state gives an extra benefit to SC/ST farmers.

documents.name: Quotation or estimate from an approved supplier

steps: Check with your district Horticulture/Agriculture office whether micro-irrigation applications are open.
Register on your state's micro-irrigation portal (or submit the form offline) with your documents.
Select an approved supplier and get a quotation; install only after approval.
After installation and field verification, the subsidy is paid to your bank account.
offline: Common Service Centre (CSC) for online registration help

deadline.text: Applications are taken by state departments while funds last; there is no single national last date. Apply before you buy the system.

caveats: Subsidy is a share of the notified unit cost, not of the market price. The state portal shows exact figures.
